id: title:jurajmajerik:move precompute policy out of the query runner

review.posthog_relevance: Adds runtime checks and configuration for the HogQL exposure precomputation system, including TTL schedules, minimum duration thresholds, and cohort state validation to prevent using stale or incomplete cached results.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F4.H1 introduces substantive configuration and runtime checks for the HogQL exposure precomputation system. It establishes a minimum runtime duration before cached results are used and adds database queries to detect uncalculated or calculating cohorts, preventing the use of potentially stale membership data. This represents a bounded correctness and reliability guard,
review.uncertainty: The chunk P1.F1.H1 is dominated by documentation and removal of implementation, lacking executable changes, and therefore does not contribute executable evidence. The score relies entirely on P1.F4.H1. No tier 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated, and no tier 1 maintenance-only classification is appropriate given the presence of configuration and checks.
